recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Kindling validation is replaced or if a future active core resource introduces a Patient-capable subject/patient reference without a patient search parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-12625 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-core issue reporting that the build no longer caught resources whose subject Reference could point to Patient but lacked a patient search parameter; MedicationStatement and MedicationRequest were given as examples.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 11446. In git this is 5362a6a50040a3da339ccf786dea36204185034b, '#12625 - Check for patient search parameter', which added a ResourceValidator warning for a Patient-capable subject reference missing a patient search parameter.
additional_context: The old in-repository tools/java validator source has moved to the external Kindling dependency used by the current Gradle build. The current Kindling 1.25.5-SNAPSHOT source still contains the FHIR-12625 check. MedicationRequest and MedicationStatement are active resources and both currently define subject as Reference(Patient, Group) with patient search parameters targeting Patient. FHIR-32876 is nearby patient-search background about clinical-patient target narrowing, but not the same presence check.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current source and active build toolchain already implement the approved check and the Jira-named resources already have the expected patient search parameters.

related_jiras.note: Later Published FHIR-core issue about the target list for generated clinical-patient SearchParameter; it concerns target narrowing rather than the FHIR-12625 per-resource patient search parameter presence check.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 issue asking that resources with subject ref(Patient), including MedicationStatement and MedicationRequest, have patient search parameters and that the build catch omissions.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the approved request as a build validation and search-parameter coverage correction.

evidence_items.summary: The git-svn build@11446 commit titled '#12625 - Check for patient search parameter' added a ResourceValidator warning for subject references that can be Patient but lack a patient search parameter.

evidence_items.summary: The current FHIR build depends on org.hl7.fhir:kindling and runs org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher; gradle.properties selects kindlingVersion 1.25.5-SNAPSHOT.
evidence_items.learned: The relevant current validator source is supplied by the Kindling dependency, not by the old in-repository tools/java tree.

evidence_items.summary: Current Kindling ResourceValidator checks subject search parameters, patient element search parameters, and warns when subject can reference Patient but patient search is missing.
evidence_items.learned: The FHIR-12625 validation behavior remains present in the active build toolchain.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationRequest and MedicationStatement define subject as Reference(Patient, Group) and define patient search parameters over subject with target Patient.
evidence_items.learned: The two resources named by the Jira issue currently satisfy the patient search parameter rule.
